notes.text: R. Andersson is no longer killing penalties: 3% of the team’s shorthanded time in 6 games, down from 48% last season.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 5 games cover only 33% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the third-lowest in the league (a typical team: 47%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
M. Foligno is on injured reserve and missed their last game. He is one of their more valuable skaters.

MIN.head: Minnesota faces a real test
MIN.body: Even though Vegas will be without Hanifin, while Minnesota has home-ice advantage, Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. Minnesota’s best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.
